# DMPG-retningslinjer

DMPG-retningslinjer refers to recently issued guidelines from DMPG (the Danish pediatric/child psychiatric professional body implied by the acronym in the source document) concerning the diagnostic work-up (udredning) of ADHD. In the ADHD-databasen's 2024 annual report, covering the period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, these guidelines are cited as the direct clinical rationale behind a shift in regional practice: clinicians in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] have raised the priority of somatic examination during ADHD assessment because of the guidelines' recommendations [^src1].

The guidelines matter beyond individual regional practice because they underpin the steering group's (styregruppen) formal assessment of Indikator 1, the database's indicator tracking somatic work-up in ADHD diagnosis. Citing the DMPG-retningslinjen directly, the steering group concludes that somatic examination is an essential part of ADHD assessment, both with respect to possible somatic differential diagnoses and to somatic conditions that may co-occur with ADHD [^src1]. This justification is the evidentiary backbone for why Indikator 1 remains a relevant, retained indicator in the report, set against a national development target of ≥90% [^src1].

Within the broader narrative of the 2024 report, the DMPG-retningslinjer sit at the intersection of clinical guidance and measurable performance: the report documents notable regional variation on Indikator 1, with Region Midtjylland singled out as a positive outlier showing marked improvement, while Region Sjælland's performance declined over the same period [^src1]. The guidelines are presented as one explanation for why some regions — specifically Region Midtjylland and Region Hovedstaden — have actively reprioritized resources toward somatic examination, tying professional guidance directly to observed indicator outcomes [^src1].

## Claims

**Clinical rationale:**
- I Region Midt og Region Hovedstaden har man opprioriteret at få foretaget somatisk undersøgelse pga. anbefalinger i nylige DMPG-retningslinjer vedrørende udredning af ADHD (region-midtjylland, region-hovedstaden, dmpg-retningslinjer, indikator-1) — Page 12 [^src1]
- Styregruppen vurderer jævnfør DMPG-retningslinjen, at somatisk undersøgelse er en væsentlig del af udredningen af ADHD både ift. mulige somatiske differentialdiagnoser og evt. samtidigt optrædende somatiske tilstande (dmpg-retningslinjer, indikator-1) — Page 13 [^src1]
